name: New Mexico
overview: A statewide refundable senior property-tax rebate covers owners and renters. A separate county-option rebate covers qualifying owners in participating counties.

programs.name: Property Tax Rebate for Persons 65 or Older
programs.incomeDefinition: Modified gross income of taxpayer, spouse and dependents, including nontaxable income and excluding specified sources; losses do not offset income.
programs.formulaSummary: Qualifying property tax billed plus 6% of rent, less the maximum tax liability in Table 2; apply the cap.
programs.application: PIT-RC Section 3 with PIT-1, including when filing only for refundable relief.
eligibilityNotes: At least six months’ physical presence and qualifying New Mexico residency.
Dependency, institutional residence and tax-exempt housing restrictions apply.
programs.programYear: 2025 property tax billed/rent paid; income-tax return filed in 2026.

programs.name: Additional Low Income Property Tax Rebate
programs.formulaSummary: Multiply qualifying billed property tax by the Table 3 income-tier percentage; apply cap.
programs.application: PIT-RC Section 4 with PIT-1; identify the qualifying county.
eligibilityNotes: The 2025 form lists Los Alamos, Santa Fe, Doña Ana and Bernalillo counties.
interactions: Separate from the statewide senior rebate; apply PIT-RC coordination rules.
programs.programYear: 2025 tax year; county adoption is required.

programs.name: Real estate taxes in New Mexico itemized deductions
programs.ageRule: No separate age test applies to this deduction.
programs.incomeDefinition: New Mexico uses federal itemized deductions. Federal modified adjusted gross income can reduce the combined deduction for state and local taxes.
programs.incomeLimits: The federal combined limit starts to phase down for a 2025 single filer with modified adjusted gross income over $500,000.
programs.maximumBenefit: Eligible property taxes within the federal combined limit for state and local taxes.
programs.formulaSummary: PIT-1 line 12 carries the allowed federal itemized deduction. With no income or sales taxes on Schedule A line 5a, the line 10 add-back is zero.
programs.application: Enter the federal itemized deduction on PIT-1 line 12, mark 12a and complete the line 10 worksheet when there is an add-back.
eligibilityNotes: Use eligible real estate taxes paid on owned nonbusiness property from federal Schedule A line 5b.
interactions: The federal filing election determines whether the state computation starts with the federal standard deduction or federal itemized deductions.
programs.programYear: 2025 New Mexico income-tax return, using taxes paid in 2025 and the 2025 federal Schedule A.

sources.title: 2025 New Mexico PIT-1 instructions, line 10 worksheet

researchNotes: The 2025 PIT-RC Section 4 rebate covers participating counties Los Alamos, Santa Fe, Doña Ana and Bernalillo.
The general low-income comprehensive rebate and the property-tax-specific rebates follow separate rules.
